title: I Let AI Recreate Our 3D Models | Meshy7 & Smart Topology v2
author: yecats131
selftext: I periodically test AI 3D generation tools. I wanted to do something a little different, so for this video I am using references from our own game assets. We'll look at the AI model alongside the original model and talk through what is and isn't working.

comments.author: BurningRome
comments.body: Nice analysis on a real world project. Would love to see you test out alternative 3D generators like Tripo with the recent P2 update.

replies.author: yecats131
replies.body: Oh! I was planning on doing Tripo P2 today. :D also, thank you very much for the compliment.

comments.author: florodude
comments.body: Just based on the title, I wouldn't think it's good enough. For me to get anything I can animate I have to retopo. We're like 70% of the way there. if you did an isometric top down project or something you may be able to use something out of the box, but faces get pretty darn cursed, even if you bake higher topo maps on top

replies.author: yecats131
replies.body: I think it's "good enough" depending on what you're generating with it. It's also important to go in with the mindset of 1) not using the textures and 2) using what comes out as a base that you intend to refine.
